source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 18ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Μαρτινιανός ο εν τοις Αρεοβίνθου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 18 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and its body is one sentence: the time in which he lived is unknown, he practised asceticism in the church of the Mother of God of the Areobindus quarter, and he fell asleep in peace. **He is not the corpus's Martinianus of the Seven Sleepers or any other of the name**, none of which is kept on this day or attached to that church. **The display name keeps the church**, «ο εν τοις Αρεοβίνθου», which is all that distinguishes him. **The page says outright that his epoch is unknown**, so there is no `dates` object and none could be inferred. **No `locations` object.** No hymn, no relics, no parents and no wonder is printed.
